text: Once upon a time, in Dresden, by the river Elbe...
a curious kid met a beige box, called the Commodore sixty-four.
After his military service, Lars swapped his boots for bytes...
and trained as an IT specialist, for system integration.
Today, he pulls the strings of complex server platforms, with Puppet.
He builds pipelines with Ansible, Foreman and Jenkins, so every deployment flows smoothly downstream.
And when the right tool doesn't exist yet? He simply writes it, in Python.
If it plugs in... he's curious.
Lars Krahl. Hooked since the C sixty-four.
